# Roof racks and storage systems

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

[Partial] Measure roof centers, punch dimples, drill holes, apply WD-40, insert four Vibration-Damping U-Bolts, thread chrome bolts, secure assemblies onto bike tube liners, and tighten hardware. [t40]

[Partial] Test fit and drill out quick fists to install roof racks with bolted hose clamps. [t940]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

1. [Partial] Test fit the hose clamp over the deep lip to determine drilling location.
2. [Partial] Drill out the inside of the quick fist component so a bolt fits through it.

_Procedure reported by [t940]. Photos of this job are in the source: <https://www.xterranation.org/index.php?threads/mini-how-to-quick-fists-on-roof-rack.3081/>_

## Tools

- Speed square [t40]
- Punch [t40]
- [Partial] Hose clamps [t940]
- [Partial] Bolt [t940]

## Parts

- Garvin-style roof rack, E-Z-Go TXT 94-13 model: Heavy duty black powder coated steel, measures 5"H x 32"W x 52"L [t40]
- Hose clamps [t940]
- Quick Fists [t940]
- Vibration-damping U-bolts: Four units from McMaster-Carr [t40]

## Tips & gotchas

- Use a bike tube as an inner liner for the U-bolt housing/bracket. [t40]
- Apply WD-40 to help seat the vibration-damping U-bolts through the drilled holes. [t40]

## Common mistakes

- [Partial] Drilling directly through the hose clamp, which is difficult. [t940]
